Admission asks for a reading sample. The node hands over 25 submissions, eight with sealed verdicts, and a key activates only when those eight return within one point of the sealed score. A generous 3 on a planted jade answer fails the set; the key waits 14 days.

Honest reading takes 75 minutes, sealed entries hidden among 500 character answers. Fifty keys cost 62 operator hours, near 375 dollars at six an hour, every quarter.

A cutter proves the eye on rough stone before the jade; a loom wants one hand per thread, and a reader who has to wander through fifty arguments starts skimming.
